newsitem.title: USA: Trident sees Q4 results below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Trident sees Q4 results below expectations.

text.p: Trident Microsystems Inc said Friday it expects sales and net income in the fourth quarter to be below expectations due to a weak 2D graphics business, and the price war in that market.
The company said it expects fourth quarter revenues to be about 25 percent below the $46.5 million reported in the third quarter, and expects "interest and other income" to be about $675,000.
Company officials were not immediately available to elaborate on the forecasts.

"The disappointing fourth quarter results from a 2D price war caused by excess inventories among our competitors, greater than anticipated seasonal softness in PC demand and cautious buying patterns by our consumers," President and Chief Executive Officer Frank Lin said in a statement.
"However, our new 3D products...have not been affected by this 2D decline and will contribute material revenue in this, their first quarter."
He expects revenues to recover in the next two quarters.
The company also said in a statment that it expects gross margin percentage in the fourth quarter to increase by one percentage point to 48.5 percent, due to the 3D product shipments.
